At the reported version the iterator returns an empty list due to the bug treating the lists as an intersection, causing the assertion to fail.

## Root cause

In src/dateutil/rrule.py, the _iter method treats BYDAY values as an intersection by requiring a day to satisfy both plain weekday (_byweekday) and ordinal weekday (_bynweekday) masks when either is present, causing mixed specifications like MO,1FR to yield no matches; the issue body and test confirm this logic error occurs regardless of frequency (MONTHLY/YEARLY).

_Written by the model from the issue, the test and the logs. The sandbox runs did not check it._

## Next actions

1. Apply the suggested fix to _iter: change the rejection condition to ((byweekday or ii.nwdaymask) and not (byweekday and ii.wdaymask[i] in byweekday) and not (ii.nwdaymask and ii.nwdaymask[i]))
2. Add regression tests for MO,1FR, FR,1FR, YEARLY;BYMONTH=1;BYDAY=SU,1MO and rrulestr forms as mentioned in the issue body
3. Verify the fix resolves the assertion error in test_byweekday_mix_union and related cases
4. Ensure existing tests still pass to avoid regressions
